en.headline: Box truck overturns after hitting barrier in San Po Kong, driver injured
en.dek: The vehicle struck an impact-absorbing barrier near Rhythm Garden around 4 a.m. on Prince Edward Road East; the driver climbed out with head and limb injuries.
body: A box truck overturned after crashing into a barrier in San Po Kong early on Wednesday, injuring the driver.

The accident occurred at about 4 a.m. as the truck travelled along Prince Edward Road East towards Kwun Tong. Near Rhythm Garden, at the fork with the Kwun Tong Bypass, the vehicle apparently lost control, hit an accordion-style impact-absorbing barrier and overturned.
The driver was briefly trapped before climbing out on his own. He suffered injuries to his head and limbs and was taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital conscious.

Photographs from the scene showed the truck lying across the lanes, with severe front-end damage, a detached front axle and scattered parts. The barrier was also badly damaged. Sources said the truck was delivering goods to convenience stores. Police are investigating.

zh.headline: 新蒲崗貨車撞欄翻側 司機受傷
zh.dek: 凌晨約4時，太子道東往觀塘方向近采頤花園，貨車失控撞風琴式防撞欄後翻側，司機頭部及手腳受傷清醒送院。
body: 新蒲崗發生貨車翻側意外。
周三凌晨約4時，一輌密斗貨車沿太子道東往觀塘方向行駛，至采頤花園對開、太子道東與觀塘繞道分岔位時，懷疑失控猛撞風琴式防撞欄，繼而翻側。
司機一度被困，其後自行爬出車外，頭部及手腳受傷，清醒由救護車送往伊利沙伯醫院治理。
現場貨車橫臥行車線上，車頭嚴重損毀，前車軸甩脫，零件散落一地，防撞欄亦損毀。據了解，貨車正運送貨物前往便利店。警方正調查原因。
